findings.reason: Single tri-state fail-closed invariant with its complementary edges (undetermined is not FAIL, and not no-violation). Normatively grounded in 基本仕様 §7.2 and 詳細設計 §7.1; operational via the DA rule table's FAIL/UNKNOWN conditions.

Precise aggregation proposition; the three fold branches are one function, not independent claims. The '(after §7.3 reachability)' qualifier correctly matches 詳細設計 §7.1/§7.3 (runtime-satisfied DA-002 targets do not count as UNKNOWN at verify-time item computation).

First clause ('can be rejected before semantic audit') is a verbatim restatement of REQ §11 '決定論的解析で明確にNGとできるTestは、LLM監査へ送る前に拒否可能であること' adding no design-level content; the verifiable design content is only the bundle-skip default and its override (詳細設計 §7.2, 別紙A §12.2 — the --include-failed flag is normative interface contract, so G does not apply).
findings.suggestion: Revise to: 'vtest audit bundle --kind test-semantic excludes by default any Test whose effective static Audit Record has a DA-001..DA-006 FAIL; a bundle for such a Test is generated only when --include-failed is passed (UNKNOWN Tests are still bundled).'

findings.reason: 'Each violation fixture goes non-PASS on its rule' imports 別紙C §18.3.2 acceptance-fixture language, making the VO's truth condition depend on a particular test corpus rather than on system behavior over arbitrary inputs. The underlying mapping (REQ §11 classes realized by DA-001..DA-006) is legitimate design content; the clean/violating directions form one detector-correctness biconditional, so no split needed.
findings.suggestion: Revise to: 'For each REQ §11 violation class there is a designated deterministic rule among DA-001..DA-006 such that any Test exhibiting that class within the rule's deterministic scope receives non-PASS on that rule, and a Test exhibiting no class receives no FAIL from any rule — for arbitrary inputs, independent of any fixture corpus.'

findings.reason: Two independent propositions: (1) record well-formedness (per-target DA-002/003 verdicts canonical, 1:1 with declared targets, mismatch/fold-contradiction => malformed E-SCAN-010, excluded from the valid set) and (2) empty-valid-set degradation (no valid record => static_audit STALE/NOT_CHECKED, never PASS). Each can fail independently — e.g. malformed detection correct while verify still emits PASS with zero valid records. Both are normative in 詳細設計 §3.6.
findings.suggestion: Split: (a) 'Per-target DA-002/DA-003 verdicts are the canonical stored form, 1:1 with declared targets; any missing/duplicate/extra target entry, mismatch with the declared set, or contradiction with the pure-static fold makes the record malformed (E-SCAN-010) and excludes it from the valid record set without extracting its per-target FAILs.' (b) 'When no valid (non-malformed, non-STALE) static Audit Record exists, static_audit is STALE (invalidated records only) or NOT_CHECKED (never audited), never PASS, regardless of runtime proof.'

findings.reason: One subject-definition invariant stated in both directions: the freshness subject is exactly the rule-relevant input set (changes to bound inputs => STALE per 基本仕様 §7.2; rule-irrelevant run/coverage config excluded from the projection per 詳細設計 §1.3 and 別紙C §18.3.2). Staleness here is designed vtest behavior, not a dogfood evidence-judging rule, so H does not apply.

Joins two obligations with different actors and independent failure modes: the adapter-contract obligation (rule returns UNKNOWN when it cannot bind referenced analysis inputs into the freshness subject — 基本仕様 §7.2) and the core-side enforcement (core detects a referenced fragment without a DTO and refuses to use the verdict as PASS — 詳細設計 §7.1). Core enforcement is not an edge case of the adapter obligation; either can fail while the other holds.
findings.suggestion: Split: (a) 'A static rule that referenced analysis inputs (helper, expanded source, symbol table, etc.) it cannot bind into the freshness subject returns UNKNOWN, never PASS.' (b) 'When core detects that the adapter referenced a source fragment but returned no corresponding DTO, core does not use that rule verdict as PASS.'

findings.reason: '§11.2-selected latest valid Evidence' is ambiguous and admits the forbidden reading 'latest among the valid Evidence' (fallback semantics). §11.2 evaluates the latest Evidence of the Test, and 詳細設計 §7.3 explicitly forbids falling back to older valid Evidence when the latest is invalid; 別紙C §18.3.2 has a dedicated bullet for this. As worded, the VO could be satisfied by an implementation that does exactly what the design prohibits. The FAIL-never-overridden and non-PASS-unmet clauses are complementary edges of the same join, not compound.
findings.suggestion: Revise to: 'Per-target DA-002 UNKNOWN reachability is satisfied only when the latest Evidence selected by §11.2 has evidence_validity = PASS and its per-target target_execution = PASS (checked: true, count > 0); if the latest Evidence is invalid there is no fallback to older valid Evidence; per-target DA-002 FAIL is never overridden by runtime proof; target_execution FAIL/UNKNOWN/NOT_CHECKED leaves the requirement unmet.'

findings.reason: Joins two mechanisms at different phases: (1) audit-time verdict assignment — a declared target whose call does not appear statically in the Test body gets per-target DA-003 UNKNOWN, never vacuous PASS/FAIL (詳細設計 §7.2); (2) verify-time aggregation — runtime coverage never substitutes DA-003, so DA-003 UNKNOWN/FAIL contributes to static_audit even when DA-002 reachability is runtime-satisfied (詳細設計 §7.3, 別紙C §18.3.2). An adapter could vacuous-PASS invisible calls while the join is correct, or vice versa. The subprocess-E2E-cannot-reach-PASS clause is the derived consequence, not a third proposition.
findings.suggestion: Split: (a) 'A declared target whose call appears nowhere statically in the Test body receives per-target DA-003 UNKNOWN (never vacuous PASS or vacuous FAIL).' (b) 'Runtime coverage never substitutes DA-003: DA-003 UNKNOWN/FAIL contributes unchanged to static_audit even when the same target's DA-002 reachability is satisfied by runtime proof — hence a call-invisible (subprocess E2E) Test cannot reach static_audit = PASS.' Attach the consequence to (b).

findings.reason: Clause 1 (core never interprets adapter-specific AST/assertion syntax/call graph — 基本仕様 §7.2, 詳細設計 §7.1) is an architectural layering invariant verified by inspection of the core/adapter boundary; clauses 2-3 (capability absent => NOT_CHECKED; reported incompleteness/analysis limits => UNKNOWN, never presumed no-violation) form a verdict-degradation ladder with an entirely different truth condition. Independent propositions joined in one VO. Clauses 2-3 together are one fail-closed ladder (complementary cases), so they stay together.
findings.suggestion: Split: (a) 'Core interprets no adapter-specific AST, assertion syntax, or call graph; it only validates (hashes, spans, DTO completeness, encoding) and aggregates normalized rule results.' (b) 'Absent Static Audit capability yields static_audit NOT_CHECKED; adapter-reported incompleteness, analysis limits, or incomplete analysis-input sets yield UNKNOWN; neither state is ever treated as no-violation.'

findings.reason: Two independent propositions: (1) vtest-adapter-api type-surface exposes no Cargo/Rust-parser/llvm-cov types (18.3.9 bullet 1); (2) TestEntity carries only a neutral ExecutionDescriptor as execution coordinates, i.e. no filter/package/test_target fields (18.3.9 bullet 4, 基本仕様 §2.4). API type exposure and domain-model field-set have different truth conditions — the adapter API can be clean while TestEntity still holds filter, and vice versa.
findings.suggestion: 01a: 'vtest-adapter-api exposes no Cargo, Rust-parser, or llvm-cov specific types in its public surface.' 01b: 'vtest-model::TestEntity carries execution coordinates only as the language/runner-neutral ExecutionDescriptor (adapter, project, suite, opaque selector); filter, package, test_target and TestTarget are not TestEntity fields.'

findings.reason: Clause 1 ('each capability is a separate adapter contract') is a design-structure description, not a verification proposition, and is independent of clause 2 (registry rejection behavior). Capability granularity could hold while the registry accepts duplicate IDs. The three registry rejections themselves are one fail-closed registration invariant with complementary cases — fine as a single VO. Grounding: REQDEF §27 '能力を個別に提供', 詳細設計 §5.2 (six-way capability split, lines 767-770), 18.3.9 registry bullet.
findings.suggestion: 02a (rephrased to a proposition): 'An adapter can declare and provide each capability (SourceDiscovery, TestWireCodec, StaticAudit, StructuredTest, TestRunner, Coverage) independently; providing one capability never requires implementing another.' 02b: 'The registry rejects duplicate adapter IDs, declared-capability/implementation mismatch, and references to unregistered adapters.'

findings.reason: Part 1 is the boundary proof (a non-Rust adapter with non-.rs sources, non-function constructs, non-doc-comment metadata, opaque non-Rust-item-path locators registers/scans/verifies with zero changes to vtest-model/vtest-scan/vtest-verify — 18.3.9 final bullet, REQDEF §27). Part 2 is a deliverable-scope invariant (rust-cargo sole production adapter — 18.4, 詳細設計 §19 'synthetic adapterは受入fixture専用'). An extensibility capability and a shipping-scope constraint hold in entirely different situations; either can be violated alone.
findings.suggestion: 03a: 'A non-Rust adapter whose sources are not .rs, whose Test constructs are not functions, whose metadata declarations are not doc comments, and whose opaque locators are not Rust item paths can register, scan and verify without any change to vtest-model, vtest-scan or vtest-verify.' 03b: 'rust-cargo is the only registered production language adapter in the shipped product; the synthetic adapter is acceptance-fixture-only and is not shipped as a production adapter.'

findings.reason: The verify-time half collapses the normative cause-to-status mapping into a disjunction 'NOT_CHECKED/NOT_EXECUTED/UNKNOWN'. Spec pins the mapping (詳細設計 lines 770-772, 18.3.9): static-audit/coverage capability lack -> NOT_CHECKED, runner lack -> NOT_EXECUTED, and UNKNOWN belongs to 解析限界 (analysis limits), NOT capability absence. As worded, an implementation returning NOT_CHECKED for a missing runner would satisfy this VO, and UNKNOWN is misattributed to missing capability. The explicit-op/verify-time pairing itself is NOT compound: it is the one fail-closed contract stated in a single breath in the spec, partitioned over the complete operation domain.
findings.suggestion: Revised claim: 'A missing required capability aborts explicit operations with E-ADAPTER-004 and produces no change, Audit Record or Evidence; at verification, missing static-audit or coverage capability yields NOT_CHECKED, missing runner capability yields NOT_EXECUTED, and analysis limits yield UNKNOWN — none of these is ever promoted to an inferred PASS.'

findings.reason: Single hash-ownership invariant stated with its complementary negative side (adapter returns hash-uncomputed DTOs / core validates against current bytes and computes / adapter never self-finalizes). Verbatim normative grounding: 詳細設計 §1.3 line 89 and 基本仕様 §6.1 line 294; DTO検証->hash計算->具体化 order in 18.3.9.

Single delegation contract over the locator boundary: adapter interprets, core verifies the returned adapter ID/range/bytes, core never parses locator syntax. The verify-returned-values clause and never-parse clause are the two sides of the same boundary, not independent obligations. Verbatim grounding: 詳細設計 §6.1 line 901.

'Evidence binds the executing adapter ID' carries the generation-time writer obligation (18.3.3 'Evidence writerはadapter IDを必ず記録する'), which is an independent proposition from the verify-time evaluation and is already owned by VO-EXEC-03 (and legacy scoring by VO-EXEC-10). The two verify-time rules (differ -> MISMATCH; absent -> uniquely-confirmed-Rust or UNKNOWN) are complementary cases over the domain {match, differ, absent} of one freshness dimension — not compound. Not an H violation: this is vtest's own designed verifier behavior (基本仕様 §7.8).
findings.suggestion: Reword to the pure verify-time proposition and leave writer binding to VO-EXEC-03: 'At verification, an Evidence adapter ID differing from the current Test's execution adapter yields MISMATCH; an Evidence lacking adapter ID is evaluated as compatible Evidence only when the current Test is rust-cargo and Rust execution is uniquely confirmed from compat runner information and content hashes, otherwise UNKNOWN.'

findings.reason: Two fully independent obligations: (1) config-time fail-closed — unknown adapter or failed adapter-specific config validation is an operation error with no inference of available languages/capabilities (基本仕様 §2.4 line 118, verbatim quote); (2) wire-codec invariant — Rust compat fields filter/package/test_target are emitted only by the rust-cargo codec for rust-cargo Tests, and non-Rust Tests omit them with no empty/dummy/Rust-default values (基本仕様 §2.4, 18.3.9). Config validation behavior and JSON serialization behavior fail in disjoint situations.
findings.suggestion: 08a: 'An unknown adapter ID or a failed adapter-specific configuration validation is an operation error; the system never infers or back-fills available languages or capabilities.' 08b: 'Rust wire-compatibility fields (filter, package, test_target) are output only by the rust-cargo codec for rust-cargo Tests; non-Rust Tests omit them entirely — no empty, dummy, or Rust-default values are ever generated.'

findings.reason: By-reference canonical representation is a single invariant: identity = path + sha256 captured at registration (詳細設計 §3.1 'sha256: 登録時の内容ハッシュ', 基本仕様 §3.1 '仕様文書への参照（パス＋内容ハッシュ）') with its complementary negative facet '仕様文書そのものは.verify/へ複製しない' (詳細設計 §3.1) — not compound. Independently verifiable by inspecting the record schema and .verify/ contents.

First half is a verbatim restatement of the 基本仕様 §1 terminology definition — definitional, no design-level content (refs cite only definition/requirement text, no design mechanism). Second half ('no intake path treats a doc comment as the sole spec basis') has no operational criterion: 要件定義 §24 says 「想定しない」 — a scoping non-goal, not a normative MUST — and no design mechanism rejects registering the implementation source file via vtest spec add, so the claim as worded is undecidable (user-registered src file would neither pass nor fail it).
findings.suggestion: Revise to the enforceable route-exclusivity property: 'SPEC records are created and updated only by explicit vtest spec add [--update]; no scan/discovery/adapter path materializes or mutates a SPEC record — adapter doc-comment parsing yields only Test metadata and SRC ID declarations (詳細設計 §4.2, 別紙C §18.3.9), never a Specification source.'

findings.reason: Two independent propositions joined by 'and': (1) diagnostic emission — scan compares registered sha256 with the actual file and emits W-SCAN-104 on mismatch (別紙C §18.3.1 'SPEC sourceの内容hash不一致をW-SCAN-104として検出する'); (2) validity propagation — audits with that SPEC in subjects become STALE and approvals with that SPEC in the dependency closure become invalid (詳細設計 §11.4). A build could invalidate without emitting the diagnostic, or emit it while still counting audits valid — different observation surfaces (diagnostics vs. aggregation verdicts), so not one invariant with edge cases.
findings.suggestion: Split: (03a) 'At scan, each SPEC record's registered sha256 is compared with the actual file; on mismatch W-SCAN-104 is emitted.' (03b) 'While a SPEC source mismatches its registered sha256, every audit including that SPEC in subjects is invalid (STALE) and every approval including that SPEC subject in its dependency closure is invalid; none is ever counted as valid.'

findings.reason: Three independent propositions: (1) route exclusivity — the registered SPEC hash changes only via explicit vtest spec add --update (詳細設計 §11.4, 別紙A); (2) validity semantics — after re-registration the SPEC subject hash differs and prior-hash dependency entries are never accepted for the current approval state (§11.4 '以前のdependency entryを現在の承認へ流用しない', 要件定義 §25); (3) UX obligation — --update outputs that dependent audits/approvals expire (別紙A: '依存する監査・承認が失効する旨を出力する'). Each is separately falsifiable: silent auto-update at scan breaks only (1), accepting old-hash entries breaks only (2), a silent --update breaks only (3).
findings.suggestion: Split: (04a) 'The registered SPEC sha256 changes only via explicit vtest spec add --update; scan mismatch detection never mutates the stored record.' (04b) 'Re-registration changes the SPEC subject hash; approval dependency entries bound to the prior hash are never accepted as satisfying the current dependency closure.' (04c) 'vtest spec add --update surfaces to the user that dependent audits and approvals expire.'

findings.reason: Semicolon joins two independent field contracts: (1) spec_refs.spec resolves deterministically to an existing SPEC record and its current source/hash (基本仕様 §7.1, 詳細設計 §3.2); (2) section is a non-empty opaque citation core never syntactically checks against the body, and no syntactic in-body check can yield PASS (詳細設計 §11.1: empty section → MISMATCH; 'opaqueなsection citationの本文内存在をcoreが構文的に判定した結果だけでPASSにしない'). Different fields, different probes: a build could resolve spec refs correctly yet parse sections into PASS, or keep sections opaque while resolving nondeterministically. The opaqueness half (non-empty floor + no-syntactic-PASS ceiling) is one invariant and stays together.
findings.suggestion: Split: (05a) 'Each spec_refs.spec resolves deterministically to an existing SPEC record and its current source/hash; unresolvable references yield MISSING/MISMATCH per §11.1.1, never PASS.' (05b) 'spec_refs.section is a non-empty opaque citation: empty section yields MISMATCH; core performs no syntactic check of the citation's presence in the Specification body, and no syntactic in-body check can yield PASS — semantic validity is confirmed only via audit reasons.'

findings.reason: The clause 'via one shared adapter registry' is a mechanism description ('X via Y'), not part of the falsifiable proposition; output parity does not truth-conditionally depend on the registry being literally shared, and 'shared' is only checkable by code inspection. The normative content of SPEC-BASIC §11.2 (same registry composition, same envelope, same adapter-selection errors) is fully expressible as observable parity.
findings.suggestion: Revise to: 'For identical inputs and project state, every MCP tool returns the same data/diagnostics as the corresponding CLI command with --format json, and resolves the same adapter — or raises the same adapter-selection error — as the CLI; MCP never implicitly selects a different adapter.' This keeps registry-composition parity as an adapter-selection observable per SPEC-BASIC §11.2 and SPEC-ACCEPT §18.3.8.

findings.reason: Single invariant (non-interactive completion, 別紙A §12.1 verbatim) with its complementary edge case (any confirmation prompt must be suppressible via --yes); operationally falsifiable by running each command/tool with stdin closed. Adds design-level content (--yes contract) beyond NFR-007.

One exit-code contract: the partition (0/1/2/3, verbatim SPEC-BASIC §11.1), the conflict-priority rule (詳細設計 §17.2: 3>2>1>0), and the CI-judges-on-code-alone consequence (§11.1: 'CI はこの終了コードのみで判定できる') are all facets of the same normative partition, each operationally decidable.

Two independent propositions with different input domains and failure modes: (1) the success/diagnostic envelope shape of machine output, and (2) the MCP error-channel shape. The envelope can be correct while tool errors lack candidates, and vice versa. 別紙A and 別紙C both state them as separate bullets (§12.1 vs §13.1; 18.3.8 bullets 1 vs 2).
findings.suggestion: Split into: (a) 'Every machine-readable output (CLI --format json and MCP tool results) carries a top-level {ok, data, diagnostics} envelope, each diagnostic bearing code/severity/message (and location where applicable)' [別紙A §12.1, 18.3.8]. (b) 'Invalid MCP input surfaces as a tool error containing code and message, and input-validation errors include candidates' [別紙A §13.1, 本冊 §6.3, 18.3.8 — note 18.3.8 makes candidates unconditional for 不正入力, strengthening 別紙A's 可能な限り].

findings.reason: Two independently falsifiable propositions: (1) the per-call mtime-based rescan decision (design contract, 別紙A §13.1) and (2) no stale PASS across source changes in a long-running server (acceptance property, 18.3.8). A server could perform the mtime check yet still serve a stale PASS (botched reload), or avoid stale PASS via a non-mtime mechanism — the truth conditions differ. The mtime mechanism itself is normatively pinned by 別紙A §13.1, so naming it is fine under the G carve-out.
findings.suggestion: Split into: (a) 'Every MCP tool call performs an mtime-based rescan decision at its start (本冊 §2.3), so a source modified between two calls is re-scanned before the second call is served.' (b) 'A long-running MCP server never returns a PASS computed from pre-change sources: after any source change, subsequently served verdicts reflect the post-change scan.'

findings.reason: Two fail-closed obligations over different value domains with different observables: (1) explicit operations refuse with ok:false/E-ADAPTER-004/exit 2 and zero side effects (no file change / Audit Record / Evidence), vs (2) verify/report degrade to capability-specific non-PASS values. They can fail independently — e.g. correct refusal on explicit ops but a missing runner misclassified as NOT_CHECKED instead of NOT_EXECUTED violates only the second. The current wording 'non-PASS, never PASS' also under-specifies the design's exact mapping (別紙A §12.1: W-ADAPTER-101; 18.3.9: NOT_CHECKED / NOT_EXECUTED / UNKNOWN).
findings.suggestion: Split into: (a) 'An explicit operation (create/edit/audit/run) requiring an unprovided adapter capability returns ok:false, E-ADAPTER-004, exit code 2, and produces no file change, no Audit Record, and no Evidence' [別紙A §12.1, 18.3.9, 本冊 §17.1]. (b) 'When verify/report observe a missing capability they emit W-ADAPTER-101 and the capability-specific non-PASS value — static audit/coverage lack → NOT_CHECKED, runner lack → NOT_EXECUTED, analysis limits → UNKNOWN — and a missing capability never yields PASS' [別紙A §12.1, 18.3.9].

findings.reason: Decidable coverage proposition, not a restatement: the five paths are normative (要件定義 §26 '正式に想定する', SPEC-BASIC §10 main routes), the parenthetical operationalizes 'require' into five concrete operations, and falsification is mechanical — find a §10 path operation absent from the §11.1/§11.2/別紙A §13.2 published inventory.

Single conformance invariant (JSON-RPC contract adherence, 18.3.8 verbatim) enumerated over its complementary input classes (request/notification/batch/malformed) — not compound. 'Per contract' is decidable against the external JSON-RPC 2.0/MCP contract (responses for requests, none for notifications, batch responses, parse error without crash for malformed input); stdio transport is normatively pinned by 別紙A §13.1.

Grounded verbatim in SPEC-BASIC §4.3 (and SPEC-REQDEF §17.2, SPEC-ACCEPT §18.3.5). Adds design-level content beyond the requirement: the 'every entity in scope' dimension extends the requirement's 12-item list to the entity tree, so not criterion A. The two halves ('OK only if all PASS' / 'one non-PASS forces NG') are contrapositives of one binary invariant, not compound.

Two independent propositions with different truth conditions: (1) fail-closed non-promotion during aggregation, (2) mapping of adapter capability gaps to specific values. A system could never promote non-PASS yet map runner absence to NOT_CHECKED instead of NOT_EXECUTED (violating 2 only), or map gaps correctly while promoting a non-PASS child elsewhere (violating 1 only). The claim also weakens the normative per-capability mapping (SPEC-BASIC §7.10 assigns each gap kind a specific value) into a loose disjunction 'map to NOT_CHECKED/NOT_EXECUTED/UNKNOWN'.
findings.suggestion: Split into: (02a) Fail-closed hierarchical composition: at every aggregation node Test->VO->REQ->SPEC, a child holding any of FAIL/MISMATCH/MISSING/STALE/NOT_EXECUTED/NOT_CHECKED/UNKNOWN forces that parent node to non-PASS; no non-PASS value in the requested scope is ever promoted to PASS at any level (SPEC-BASIC §7.10, SPEC-ACCEPT §18.3.5) — per-node framing keeps it distinct from VO-REPORT-01's overall verdict. (02b) Adapter capability gaps map per-capability and never to PASS: missing static-audit/coverage capability -> affected items NOT_CHECKED; missing runner capability -> execution-related items NOT_EXECUTED; declared analysis limits -> UNKNOWN (SPEC-BASIC §7.10, SPEC-IFACE §12.1, W-ADAPTER-101/102).

findings.reason: Two independently falsifiable obligations: (a) the displayed representative follows the priority order — can fail while detail is complete; (b) detail output preserves every child value and all coexisting grounds — can fail while the representative is correct. Different failure modes, so compound per D. Additionally the claim says only 'the fixed priority order' without stating the order, which is not self-containedly decidable (mild C); the concrete chain is in SPEC-BASIC §4.3.
findings.suggestion: Split into: (03a) When multiple non-PASS values coexist among aggregated children, the representative value shown at the parent is selected by the fixed priority FAIL > MISMATCH > MISSING > STALE > NOT_EXECUTED > NOT_CHECKED > UNKNOWN (SPEC-BASIC §4.3). (03b) Detail output is lossless under aggregation: every child's individual check value remains inspectable, and when multiple non-PASS conditions hold simultaneously on one item, all grounds are retained and presented (SPEC-BASIC §4.3, SPEC-DOGFOOD-M3 §11.1 and §11.2).

findings.reason: Three propositions with independent truth conditions: report/verify aggregation identity (SPEC-IFACE §12.2 vtest report), dual output formats, and JSON completeness (SPEC-IFACE §12.2 vtest verify lines on ground lists and per-target lists). Any one can fail while the others hold. Also 'both text and JSON are emitted' misstates the refs (E): SPEC-BASIC §7.10 and SPEC-IFACE §12.1 say both formats are AVAILABLE — default human text, JSON via --format json — not emitted together in one invocation.
findings.suggestion: Split into: (04a) For an identical scope and item set, report produces the same aggregation results as verify — same per-item values, representative values, and overall verdict — and includes complete grounds: audit record IDs, Evidence IDs, diagnostics (SPEC-IFACE §12.2 vtest report, SPEC-ACCEPT §18.3.5). (04b) Both output formats are available (default human text; --format json), and the JSON form is lossless relative to text: it returns the same ground lists (e.g. per-Test test_traceability grounds) and the complete per-target list per §3.7 with no omission (SPEC-BASIC §7.10, SPEC-IFACE §12.1, §12.2 vtest verify).

findings.reason: The claim drops the quote's own parenthetical '（操作コマンドでは成功）': SPEC-DOGFOOD-M3 §17.2 defines exit 0 as 'requested-scope verification OK, or success for operation commands'. As written, 'Exit code 0 is returned only when the requested scope verifies OK' is falsified by any operation command (e.g. vtest spec add) correctly exiting 0 — the universal 'only' is not what the refs state. The rest (2 = rejection with no verification result, priority 3>2>1>0) is accurately grounded, and the exit-code table plus its tie-break is one contract, not compound.
findings.suggestion: Revise claim to track the table: 'Exit code 0 is returned only when the requested scope's verification result is OK or, for operation commands, the operation succeeds; 1 only for verification NG (including scan/doctor completing with E-SCAN-*); operation rejection exits 2 and generates no verification result; when multiple outcomes coexist in one run, precedence is 3 (internal error) > 2 (rejection) > 1 (NG) > 0.'

findings.reason: Normatively grounded: SPEC-ACCEPT §18.3.5 states the three roles must use unique branch symbols, and SPEC-IFACE §12.2 (vtest verify) specifies the prefix-construction rule including that an ancestor's own branch mark is never inherited by descendant lines. Not G: SPEC-DOGFOOD-M3 §19 leaves only glyph choice and wrapping to the implementation, and the claim constrains structure, not glyphs. The two clauses are complementary consequences of the single prefix-construction invariant, not compound.

Single per-pair-locality invariant (each pair verdict computed from that pair alone and never overridden by a cross-pair rule), stated as positive + complementary negative — the criterion-D carve-out, not a compound. Grounded verbatim in SPEC-BASIC §2.2 (line 102) and adds design content beyond REQ-P-001 (explicit exclusion of an upstream-priority resolution rule, independence of pair verification). Falsifiable via the P-001 canonical example (MATCH/MISMATCH/MATCH) which exercises both clauses jointly. Anticipated attack on 'presented as MISMATCH' fails: §7.5/§8.3 fix the design vocabulary — 不一致→MISMATCH, while coverage gaps (MISSING/FAIL) and non-execution states (NOT_CHECKED/STALE/UNKNOWN) are explicitly distinct categories, so 'disagreement' in the VO tracks the design's own term.

Two defects. (C) 'never rewrites any canon layer to resolve a detected inconsistency' is intent-qualified: the system legitimately writes canon (evidence/audit records are 追記型 canon per SPEC-BASIC §2.1, and spec/VO registration writes declaration-layer .verify/ records), so truth hinges on the undecidable purpose of a write, not on an observable property. (A/C) The tail clause 'the fix-target choice stays outside the system' restates REQ-P-001/OOS-002/別紙C §18.4 verbatim with no operational criterion ('outside the system' is not decidable from system behavior); its verifiable shadow is already carried by VO-P001-01 (no canonical side) and VO-P001-03 (audit content).
findings.suggestion: Revise to an operation-scoped write invariant: 'Comparison/verification operations (verify, scan, audit bundle/submit, run) mutate no canon layer except appending new evidence/audit records (追記型, SPEC-BASIC §2.1); existing declaration, implementation, and evidence records are never modified or deleted by these operations — a detected MISMATCH persists in output rather than being eliminated by a system-initiated canon write — and no output or record field designates which artifact must be changed.' The operation scoping is load-bearing (registration commands DO write declaration canon); the final clause is decidable because record fields are contract.

findings.reason: (D) Three independent propositions with different truth conditions and different error codes: verdict-vocabulary enforcement (E-AUDIT-004, 詳細設計 §8.4 item 4), reasons-structure enforcement (E-AUDIT-005, §8.4 item 5), and no-fix-proposal — an implementation can satisfy any one while violating the others. (E) The no-fix-proposal leg's only textual basis is the §8.6 参考プロンプト, which the design explicitly marks non-normative ('監査エージェントのプロンプト・スキル構成はツールの責務外だが、参考として…骨子を示す'); 'solicited' is not a vtest behavior at all (vtest builds bundles, not prompts). Additionally 'confined to the kind's fixed verdict vocabulary plus claim/basis reasons' is factually wrong against §8.3: the submission schema also carries exclusions, auditor, and confidence, and no unknown-field rejection for submissions is specified anywhere (E-SCAN-006 covers adapter declarations only).
findings.suggestion: Split into: (03a) A submission whose verdict is outside the kind's fixed vocabulary (test-semantic / impl-consistency: PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN; spec-coverage / vo-coverage: COMPLETE/INCOMPLETE/UNKNOWN, §8.3) is rejected with E-AUDIT-004 and no audit record is created. (03b) A submission with empty reasons, or any reason lacking a claim or at least one basis, is rejected with E-AUDIT-005 and no audit record is created. (03c) Accepted audit records contain only the §3.6 record-contract fields, none of which can carry a fix-target designation or fix proposal — phrased against what accepted records contain (record fields are contract), NOT against submission rejection, since unknown-field rejection for submissions is unspecified. Drop the 'solicited' half entirely as non-normative (§8.6 is explicitly 責務外/参考).

findings.reason: Single invariant (stored status never counts) with its complementary legacy-input edge case; fully grounded in 詳細設計 §3.3 (verbatim) and 別紙C §18.3.1. W-STORE-001 is design contract.

Grounded in 詳細設計 §3.5 approved-derivation formula, 基本仕様 §9 (追記型, verbatim lapse sentence), §16.2 (automatic draft via hash binding). Lapse-by-derivation-not-mutation is the complementary statement of one invariant, not compound.

One well-formedness contract on the dependencies field: exact closure content, canonical kind/id sort, subject bound only via subject_hash — all stated as one rule in 詳細設計 §3.5 (quote verbatim at line 337).

Two independent propositions with different domains and failure modes: (1) validity of existing approvals under SPEC record/source change (詳細設計 §3.5, §11.4, 基本仕様 §9); (2) creation-time obligation that dependency hashes bind current content (別紙A §12.2 line 103 '現在の…上流依存closureに束縛された承認レコードを追加する' is itself normative). A buggy writer copying stale entries makes approve exit 0 while the VO derives draft — VO-02 treats that record as correctly invalid and VO-06 never fires (resolution succeeded), so no other VO covers a successful approve yielding an immediately-approved record.
findings.suggestion: 04a: SPEC dependency hashes bind both the SPEC record and its referenced source; a change to either — including re-registration via `spec add --update` — lapses every approval containing that entry to draft (詳細設計 §3.5, §11.4, 基本仕様 §9). 04b: Approval creation binds dependency hashes to current content — a successful `vo approve` yields a record that derives approved at that instant; entries from prior approvals are never carried over across re-registration (別紙A §12.2, 詳細設計 §11.4).

findings.reason: Single fail-closed invariant over one input class (approvals lacking closure/hashes): history-only, W-STORE-002, never approved. Verbatim in 基本仕様 §9 and 詳細設計 §3.5 (W-STORE-002 normative at §3.5 line 341); 要件定義 §25 forbids speculative validation. Verifier-behavior VO, not an H-class dogfood judging rule.

Fail-closed creation gate fully normative: E-APPROVAL-001 (詳細設計 §17.1), exit 2 (§17.2, 別紙A §12.2 '終了コード2としてrecordを追加しない'), no-record in 別紙C §18.3.1. Error code and exit code are design contract, so G does not apply; '完全・currentに解決' is operationalized by §3.5 closure definition plus hash currency.

Not a mere REQ restatement: the human/agent kind enum, required identifier, optional model, and audit-record basis[] are design-schema content (詳細設計 §3.5 record schema, 別紙A §12.2 flags). The trailing who/what/grounds clause is 基本仕様 §9's own normative wording (誰が・何を・どの根拠で), operationalized by the persisted record fields.

Verbatim contract in 別紙A §12.2 line 106: edit on an approved VO warns, is permitted, and the approval auto-lapses via hash mismatch (§16.2). Distinct truth domain from VO-02 (behavior of the edit operation, not the derivation formula); permitted-with-warning plus its consequence is one operation contract, not compound. CLI command naming is normative in 別紙A, so G does not apply.

Both clauses are normatively grounded: SPEC-BASIC §12 (init creates .verify/ and never modifies existing code) and SPEC-IFACE §12.2 vtest init (existing .verify/ -> error, exit code 2). The two clauses are one non-destructiveness invariant of init over complementary input domains (fresh project vs already-initialized project), so the D carve-out applies; exit code 2 gives an operational criterion.

Merges two separate obligations from two distinct SPEC-BASIC §12 bullets with disjoint failure modes: (1) read-path tolerance — partial canonical state (missing SPEC/REQ/VO, Test metadata, Audit, Evidence) remains readable — and (2) judgment-path mapping — verify maps each absence to its corresponding non-PASS value. An implementation can satisfy one and violate the other (readable but maps a missing audit to PASS; or maps correctly but aborts reading a partial repository). Different operations, different truth conditions. Secondarily, 'its specific non-PASS value' should be anchored to the §4.1/§11.1 mapping to stay decidable.
findings.suggestion: Split into: (a) A project missing parts of SPEC/REQ/VO, Test metadata declarations, Audits, or Evidence remains readable — scan/read operations complete on the partial state without aborting (SPEC-BASIC §12). (b) vtest verify maps each missing canonical artifact or verification fact to its corresponding non-PASS value of the §4.1 state model (missing artifact -> MISSING, no Evidence -> NOT_EXECUTED, no audit -> NOT_CHECKED, per 詳細設計 §11.1), never to PASS, and partial state never aggregates to overall OK (SPEC-BASIC §12, §4.1).

findings.reason: Three independently falsifiable propositions joined by the 'empty sets never complete' pattern, but instantiated at three different check items over three disjoint value domains and evaluation points (詳細設計 §11.1: spec_coverage at SPEC over the registered-SPEC set; vo_coverage at REQ over its VO set; test_existence at leaf VO over its covering-test set). Falsifying one clause says nothing about the others — this is the same principle applied at three layers, not one invariant with edge cases. The absorbed claims confirm criterion I: REQ-SPEC-INTAKE#5 (empty registered-SPEC set) and REQ-AGGREGATION#9 (empty aggregation domain) are fail-closed obligations over different value domains, i.e. different truth conditions were merged.
findings.suggestion: De-merge into three VOs: (a) full verification or a requested scope with 0 registered SPECs yields spec_coverage = MISSING, never PASS (SPEC-BASIC §7.4, 詳細設計 §11.1, 別紙C §18.3.5) — carries absorbed REQ-SPEC-INTAKE#5; (b) an active REQ with 0 corresponding VOs yields vo_coverage = MISSING (SPEC-BASIC §7.4, 詳細設計 §11.1); (c) a leaf VO with 0 covering Tests yields test_existence = MISSING (詳細設計 §11.1) — (b)/(c) share absorbed REQ-AGGREGATION#9's empty-set fail-closed intent but over their own domains.

findings.reason: Conflates two normatively distinct failure modes with different mandated outcomes. Hard adapter discovery failure (adapter call rejected, E-ADAPTER-*/registry/config error) is an operation error: exit code 2 and no scan result is generated (SPEC-BASIC §2.1 '空のscanとして成功扱いしない', SPEC-IFACE §12.2 vtest scan) — no ref prescribes test_traceability = UNKNOWN for that branch, since no verification result exists at all. Only an incomplete/unparseable discovery result (DiscoveryBatch Incomplete, E-SCAN-001) is normatively mapped to UNKNOWN (詳細設計 §5.1 line 587, §11.1 'discovery結果が不完全または解析不能ならUNKNOWN'). The blanket 'test_traceability becomes UNKNOWN' half is therefore ungrounded (E) over part of the stated antecedent, and the two branches have different truth conditions (D).
findings.suggestion: Split into: (a) A rejected adapter discovery invocation (E-ADAPTER-* / registry / config error) is an operation error: no scan result is produced, exit code 2, and it is never reported as a successful 0-test scan (SPEC-BASIC §2.1, SPEC-IFACE §12.2 vtest scan, 別紙C §18.3.1) — scope wording to the discovery invocation path to avoid duplicating VO-ADAPTER-08. (b) An incomplete or unparseable discovery result is never treated as a complete 0-test discovery: the affected verification becomes UNKNOWN and test_traceability = UNKNOWN, which cannot PASS (詳細設計 §5.1, §11.1). Absorbed REQ-ADAPTER-BOUNDARY#4 (no speculative promotion to PASS) attaches to (b); its capability-shortfall aspect is already covered by VO-AGG-07 / VO-ADAPTER-04.

findings.reason: Verbatim normative contract from SPEC-IFACE §12.2 vtest verify (lines 225-227): on non-PASS test_traceability, each unregistered or mis-corresponding Test is listed with adapter ID, source location, diagnostic code, and verdict under Project checks, and JSON returns the same ground list. The named fields and text/JSON parity are interface contract, so criterion G's carve-out applies; content-plus-parity is one reporting obligation for one check item, not a compound; 'mis-corresponding' is decidable via the 詳細設計 §11.1 test_traceability conditions.

Both clauses are the two directions of one LLM-boundary invariant, quoted as a single contract in SPEC-BASIC §7.3 (vtest never calls out; AI verdicts enter only via bundle/submit/store). Falsifiable by dependency/code audit and by injecting a verdict outside the submit path.

Single bundle-completeness contract matching 詳細設計 §8.1 table + §8.2 schema; 'content hashes and revision' is normative in SPEC-BASIC §7.3 step 1. Claim omits related/sibling test lists from the §8.1 row, which weakens but does not invalidate the VO (under-coverage is not a reject criterion).

One validation gate (詳細設計 §8.4 checks 1-5, E-AUDIT-001/002/003/004/005) with its enumerated rejection cases; the closing 'reasonless verdict never accepted' is the 要件定義 §6 complement, not an independent proposition.

Compound: binding + auto-STALE (SPEC-BASIC §7.3, §8.5) is one invariant, but the canonical-Locator identity clause (§3.6 'subjectsのtarget entryはcanonical Locator...宣言した綴りを記録しない') is an independent obligation with its own failure mode (a record can bind and STALE correctly while recording the declared SRC-ID spelling) and is already owned by VO-REGISTRY-06 ('Evidence/audits store only the canonical Locator'). Keeping it here double-counts the obligation.
findings.suggestion: Revise claim to: 'Accepted audit records bind to the kind's complete subject set and content hashes; any change to the subject set or any subject's content automatically STALEs the record.' Drop the canonical-Locator clause — its owner is VO-REGISTRY-06; §3.6's no-candidate-selection for audit subjects remains covered by VO-REGISTRY-06/07 and VO-SEMAUDIT-08, so nothing is orphaned.

findings.reason: Exact aggregation invariant of 詳細設計 §8.5 (any FAIL wins, else latest; no valid record => NOT_CHECKED/STALE, never PASS). The no-record clause is the fail-closed complement, not a second proposition. Not H: this is vtest's own designed aggregation behavior, not a dogfood evidence-judging rule.

Not a mere REQ restatement: adds the design-level auditor.kind taxonomy (§3.6 deterministic|agent|human) and the non-substitution consequence, which is decidable because static_audit and semantic_audit are computed from disjoint record kinds (§11.1, 別紙C 18.3.4 'deterministic結果とagent/human結果を区別して保存・表示').

Two different truth conditions merged: the P-001 no-fix-direction prohibition (absorbed REQ-P-001#2) holds over every impl_consistency MISMATCH presentation, including MISMATCH from ambiguous resolution where no audit was ever submitted; the FAIL->MISMATCH mapping (SPEC-BASIC §7.5/§8.3) only fires at check-value derivation from submitted impl-consistency records. Disjoint failure modes: emitting fix advice vs collapsing NOT_CHECKED/STALE/UNKNOWN into MISMATCH. Hygiene: refs duplicate each section with and without '§' (18.3.4/§18.3.4, 7.5/§7.5, 8.3/§8.3, 13/§13).
findings.suggestion: Split: (1) 'A detected spec/VO/Test vs implementation inconsistency is presented as check value MISMATCH — including the no-audit ambiguous-resolution case — and the impl_consistency presentation never determines which artifact should be fixed' (reqs REQ-P-001+REQ-SEMANTIC-AUDIT; refs REQDEF §13, SPEC-BASIC §7.5; carries absorbed [REQ-P-001#2]; scope it to the impl_consistency item so it does not re-create VO-P001-01/02). (2) 'impl-consistency submissions use PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN; the Audit Record keeps the submitted verdict and the check item maps PASS->PASS, FAIL->MISMATCH, UNKNOWN->UNKNOWN, never overwriting resolution-derived MISSING/MISMATCH, NOT_CHECKED, or STALE' (req REQ-SEMANTIC-AUDIT; refs SPEC-BASIC §7.5, 詳細設計 §8.3, 別紙C §18.3.4; absorbed empty). Also dedupe the '§'-less ref entries.

findings.reason: Single fail-closed resolution invariant: all clauses fire on the same trigger (unresolvable target at impl-consistency bundle generation); no-bundle/no-candidate is the behavior facet and MISSING-vs-MISMATCH is the recorded-value facet, stated as consecutive normative sentences in 詳細設計 §8.1 and 別紙C 18.3.4 ('両者を一括して同一の状態値にしない'). Absorbed REQ-P-001#3 (no candidate auto-selection) shares this exact trigger domain, so the merge is sound. Hygiene only: refs duplicate sections with and without '§'.

Single SPEC-subject-binding invariant with its STALE consequence; 'even for limited-scope PASS' is the complementary edge case stated verbatim in SPEC-BASIC §7.5, 詳細設計 §8.5, and 別紙C 18.3.4. Staleness here is vtest's own designed behavior, not a dogfood evidence rule (not H).

Exact normative completeness invariant from SPEC-BASIC §7.5 / 詳細設計 §8.1 (all targets' implementation sources and adapter structure info; no target omitted). Distinct from VO-SEMAUDIT-02 (test-semantic bundle) as it governs the impl-consistency kind.

Joins two independent propositions: (1) execution scoping — only the selected registered Tests execute, via exact-match selectors (別紙C §18.3.3 bullet 1, 詳細設計 §9.2) — and (2) the result-line parse mapping with its fail-closed anomaly handling (詳細設計 §9.3). A run that executes extra/substring-matched tests but parses correctly violates only (1); a run that scopes correctly but records Evidence despite a missing result line violates only (2). Different truth conditions, different observation points (command construction vs stdout interpretation).
findings.suggestion: Split: (a) 'Only the selected registered Tests execute, and selectors are applied exact-match — a test whose selector merely prefixes/contains another never runs or contributes results.' (b) 'For each requested filter the result line maps ok→PASS, FAILED→FAIL, ignored→NOT_EXECUTED with no Evidence; a missing result line (E-EXEC-002) or exit-code/result-count contradiction (E-EXEC-003) fails the run and records no Evidence (基本仕様 §7.10: runnerの確定的失敗でもEvidenceを生成しない).'

findings.reason: Single fail-closed invariant — Evidence exists only when the full generation precondition holds, atomically (never partial) — stated with its enumerated complementary edge cases (build failure E-EXEC-001, runner failure/capability lack E-ADAPTER-004 per 基本仕様 §7.10, ambiguity E-SCAN-004/011 per 詳細設計 §9.4, mid-run state change E-EXEC-004 per 別紙C §18.3.3). All triggers share the identical truth-condition template.

Over-claims relative to the normative text: 詳細設計 §9.4 permits recorded Evidence with revision commit:null (取得失敗時) and §3.7 permits execution_state complete:false / hash:null as recordable history — both explicitly legitimate records that merely can never reach evidence_validity=PASS. The unconditional 'binds HEAD revision and a complete Execution State subject' is falsified by design-permitted records.
findings.suggestion: Revise to: 'Each Evidence record binds test subject hash, per-target canonical Locators+construct hashes in declared order with no gaps or duplicates, and adapter ID; revision and Execution State subject fields are always present, with degraded states explicitly marked (commit:null; complete:false with hash:null) rather than omitted or fabricated.' (The never-PASS consequence of degraded fields belongs to VO-EXEC-04.)

findings.reason: Single validity decision table matching 詳細設計 §11.2 conditions 1-5 with the exact breach→value mapping (1/2/3/4-hash→STALE, 4-incomplete→UNKNOWN, 5-mismatch→MISMATCH, 5-unverifiable→UNKNOWN). Evidence-admissibility here is vtest's own designed check item (evidence_validity), so H does not apply.

Single non-reuse propagation invariant: the derivation of test_execution/runtime_result/target_execution from evidence state is one function, and the no-Evidence→NOT_EXECUTED branch is its complementary edge case (詳細設計 §11.2, 基本仕様 §7.8 final paragraph, 別紙C §18.3.3 verbatim).

Single TEV derivation: target_execution = fold(map(count_i)); per-target mapping and the FAIL>UNKNOWN>PASS fold are stages of one decision table, presented as one block in all four refs. Borderline A (要件定義 §16 states the fold), but the per-target result values and count>0→PASS criterion are design-level content (詳細設計 §10.2, 別紙C §18.3.6).

Single fail-closed mapping over non-measurement modes (skip/no-tool→NOT_CHECKED, analysis limit→UNKNOWN, none→PASS), structurally parallel to the kept VO-EXEC-04 decision table. --fast and checked:false are design-normative contract (詳細設計 §10.3, §3.7), so G's carve-out applies; checked:false for the tool-unavailable path is the only representation §3.7's schema admits.

Single entry-set integrity invariant: canonical-Locator identity (not declared spelling) plus 1:1 correspondence with the resolved canonical Source Target set, fail-closed on missing/duplicate/extra/mismatched entries (詳細設計 §3.7, §10.2; 別紙C §18.3.6; verify-time re-resolution covered by 別紙C §18.3.3).

Mirrors the normative conditional structure of 基本仕様 §7.9 exactly: attributed boundary-crossing execution counts toward per-target PASS; unattributable→UNKNOWN, unmeasurable→NOT_CHECKED, capability lack never fabricates results (詳細設計 §10.1/§10.2 '能力の有無で計測結果を捏造しない'). 'Must attribute' reads with its immediate fallbacks, so it does not over-claim mandatory capability.

Merges three independent legacy-compat rules with different input domains and different fallback values: missing Execution State→STALE, missing adapter ID→compat-evaluation-or-UNKNOWN, singular compat form→one-target-only normalization. Worse, 'never a current PASS' is factually wrong for the adapter-lacking branch: 詳細設計 §11.2 condition 5 explicitly allows the adapter欠落形 to satisfy the adapter condition via §3.7's unique compat confirmation, and '1〜5 すべて成立 → PASS' — 基本仕様 §7.8's 昇格しない covers only the UNKNOWN/MISMATCH branches.
findings.suggestion: Split: (10a) 'Evidence lacking an Execution State subject is readable as history but evidence_validity=STALE, never current PASS (基本仕様 §7.8, 詳細設計 §3.7).' (10b) 'Evidence lacking adapter ID is evaluated as compat Evidence only when the current Test is rust-cargo and runner kind plus content hashes uniquely confirm Rust execution — in which case it can satisfy §11.2 condition 5; otherwise UNKNOWN, and explicit adapter mismatch is MISMATCH.' (10c) 'Singular compat form (hashes.target_fn / scalar target_execution) normalizes to a one-element list only for Tests declaring exactly one target with subject and construct hashes proven; for multi-target Tests it is never evaluated as a valid PASS (詳細設計 §3.7, 別紙C §18.3.3).'

findings.reason: 'with candidates' is distributed over ALL failure classes, but 別紙A §14.2's per-validator table attaches ＋候補 only to symbol-exists and enum-variant-exists; vo-exists/test-exists, unique-fn-name, rust-file, missing-required, and unknown-field are E-OP-001 WITHOUT candidates. §12.2/§17.1's blanket 候補付き is a summary; the precise contract is §14.2. As written the VO would falsely fail a conforming implementation that omits candidates on an unknown-field error.
findings.suggestion: Structured input is checked at accept time: unresolvable target, missing VO/Test ref, duplicate Test ID, unknown field, or missing required field rejects as E-OP-001; resolution failures (target symbol, enum variant) additionally carry adapter-provided candidates in the common envelope (本冊 §6.3, 別紙A §14.2).

findings.reason: Two independent propositions. The quote (別紙C §18.3.7 bullet 4) covers only form-scoped validator applicability; the 'unresolvable free text is accepted' clause comes from a different rule (別紙A §14.2 enum-variant-exists row / 本冊 §6.3 best-effort) and, unqualified, is FALSE: an unresolvable symbol field is free text too and IS rejected with E-OP-001＋候補 — contradicting VO-STRUCTOP-01.
findings.suggestion: Part 1: Validators are form-scoped — required values and unknown fields are always checked; symbol, VO/Test ref, ident, path are checked only when the chosen Form declares the field and validator, never demanded uniformly of all adapters (§18.3.7). Part 2: Best-effort validators (enum-variant-exists when `expect` is not Type::Variant form) accept unresolvable free-form values instead of rejecting (別紙A §14.2, 本冊 §6.3).

findings.reason: The desired-state/diff preamble is mechanism description (§8.2 'X works via Y'), and 'full desired state' is not even universally true of the official surface — 別紙A §12.2 `--set` declares 指定フィールドのみのあるべき値. Idempotence (§18.3.7 '同じdesired stateの再適用は冪等になる') and regeneration determinism (§15.3 fixed key order + doc-line preservation) are independently falsifiable: an implementation can drop free doc-comment lines on first edit and be idempotent thereafter.
findings.suggestion: Part 1: Re-applying an identical desired state via Create/Edit produces zero file change (idempotent, §18.3.7). Part 2: Annotation blocks are regenerated with keys always in the fixed order (id, covers, target, intent, input, expect, kind, case, related) and non-@vtest free doc-comment lines are preserved in their relative position (別紙A §15.3). Drop the desired-state/diff preamble.

findings.reason: Edit-boundary content itself is sound (別紙A §15.2 steps 4-5, §15.4 dual check, §17.1 E-OP-003; pre/post checks are complementary halves of one invariant, not compound). But the absorbed REQ-PARALLEL-DEV#1 anchors to 要件定義 §29 '一つのTest操作が他Testへ波及しにくい', whose domain is ALL Test operations; this VO covers Edit only, and no other VO (incl. VO-STRUCTOP-09) covers Create non-interference. The absorbed text is unrecoverable in-repo (only the marker exists), so the merge silently narrowed the input domain.
findings.suggestion: Keep the edit claim verbatim; de-merge the absorbed marker into a separate Create-scoped claim: 'Create inserts a new Test construct without altering any existing Test entity's source text (existing Tests' content hashes unchanged after create)' — or confirm from the superseded bottom-up list that #1 was edit-scoped, in which case KEEP as-is.

findings.reason: Verbatim §15.1: re-parse of the target file immediately before apply, E-OP-002 on re-location failure. Falsifiable via stale-scan scenario. The re-parse mechanism is rust-cargo's contract (§15 header) but the detailed design makes it normative for the only production adapter — criterion G carve-out applies.

Not mere restatement of REQ §21: '操作を提供しない' (基本仕様 §8.4, 別紙A §15.4, OOS-003) is a design-level surface-absence guarantee checkable against the CLI/MCP operation inventory, beyond the requirement's responsibility exclusion.

Verbatim 別紙C §18.3.7 bullets 1-2 and 基本仕様 §8.5: exactly-one resolution gate with its enumerated failure modes (one invariant, complementary edges). E-ADAPTER-004 correctly scoped to capability-missing only (別紙A §14.3, §17.1); no-file-change grounded ('ファイルを変更しない').

Two independent predicates. Exactly-one compat resolution with no rust-cargo fallback (0-match edge of the same predicate; §14.2, §18.3.7 bullet 3 — fallback ban is itself normative, so G carve-out) vs. no Form file rewrite ('readerは互換解決だけでFormファイルを書き換えない', §14.2): an implementation can resolve exactly-one correctly while rewriting the Form file to pin the resolved adapter — a different failure mode, independently falsifiable.
findings.suggestion: Part 1: A Form lacking `adapter` resolves only if exactly one registered adapter's built-in kind claim or deterministic schema matcher accepts it; 0 or 2+ matches reject, and core never falls back to rust-cargo on unknown kind. Part 2: Compatibility resolution is read-only — the reader never mutates the Form file as part of resolving it.

findings.reason: First clause is the verbatim acceptance proposition (§18.3.7 'create結果はscanで同じTest ID・intent・covers・targetsとして認識される'). The second clause ('the emitted source declaration is the canon, so official output and discovery cannot diverge') is design rationale (§6.1 canonicity) explaining WHY, adding no operational criterion beyond the round-trip equality.
findings.suggestion: A Test created via the official operation is re-discovered by the next scan with identical Test ID, intent, covers, and targets (create-then-scan round-trip equality).

findings.reason: Two independent propositions with different observables: (a) scan-time detection behavior after direct edits (基本仕様 §6.3, §7.1) vs (b) a data-architecture property about covers/targets persistence. Independent: detection can work while a stale external covers cache diverges. And 'cannot desync since the declaration is canon' is rationale-worded, not an operational criterion. 'Direct edits are allowed' is permission framing, not a proposition — fold into part 1.
findings.suggestion: Part 1: Direct source edits are not blocked, and the next scan/consistency check detects any resulting duplicate Test ID, dangling VO reference, or missing required metadata as non-PASS integrity findings (§6.3, §7.1). Part 2: No component persists covers/targets independently of the source declaration; scan-derived covers/targets always equal the current declaration content, so no stale external copy can be consulted (§6.1, §6.3).

findings.reason: PASS-gate condition matches 別紙C §18.3.1 and 要件定義 §7.1 verbatim; adds design-level content over the REQ summary (ManagedTestLink::One as the realization of the 1:1 mapping). The conjunction defines one PASS predicate, not multiple independent propositions. Decidable and falsifiable per gap fixture.

The three typed mappings are one derivation function's partition (not compound), but the absorbed REQ-EXISTING-PROJECT#1 has a different truth condition. Its claim text is unrecoverable; 要件定義 §23's first obligation is the surfacing/visibility obligation over pre-existing projects (VO sufficiency, existing-test-to-VO mapping, gaps visible), and its fail-closed clause spans 未実施の監査または実行 — value domains (static_audit, semantic_audit, test_execution, total OK gate) that VO-02's test_traceability typing does not cover. Absorption is unauditable and merges fail-closed obligations over different value domains.
findings.suggestion: De-merge: keep VO-REGISTRY-02's claim text unchanged with absorbed=[], and restore a #1-shaped companion VO under REQ-EXISTING-PROJECT scoped to what VO-02 does not state, e.g.: 'On a project with pre-existing sources and tests, scan surfaces every discovered-but-unregistered construct (W-SCAN-101 diagnostics displayed, 基本仕様 §12/§7.1 — display is distinct from value derivation) and partial canon (missing SPEC/REQ/VO, unaudited or unexecuted state) remains readable while yielding the corresponding non-PASS values, never a total OK (要件定義 §23).' Do not fold all five §23 obligations into one companion VO — #2/#5/#6 are absorbed elsewhere.

findings.reason: Two independent invariants joined: (1) canonicity of the adapter-owned declaration (no second persisted store; 基本仕様 §6.1/§6.3) and (2) the core/adapter parsing boundary (基本仕様 §6.1, 詳細設計 §4.1). Independent failure modes: core could cache covers into .verify/ (canon violated, boundary intact) or parse Rust doc comments itself (boundary violated, canon intact). The causal 'so' is also misattributed — desync-impossibility follows from canonicity, not from the parsing boundary.
findings.suggestion: 03a: 'The adapter-owned source declaration is the sole canon for Test Entity and covers/targets relations; no persisted second copy exists, so a direct edit of the declaration followed by scan cannot leave covers/targets desynced (基本仕様 §6.1, §6.3).' 03b: 'Core materializes Test Entities from the adapter's normalized logical fields only and never interprets adapter-owned declaration syntax or placement — comment forms, decorators, attributes, manifest syntax (基本仕様 §6.1; 詳細設計 §4.1).'

findings.reason: Two independent propositions: (1) Test ID as a resolving handle (要件定義 §7) and (2) storage policy of the SRC-to-Test reverse index (derived-only, rebuildable; 基本仕様 §2.3/§3.3/§5.3, NFR-004). A system could satisfy the handle while persisting the reverse index as a second canon, or vice versa. As written, half (1) also skirts A (near-restatement of 要件定義 §7); anchoring it to the query surface gives it design-level content.
findings.suggestion: 04a: 'From a Test ID alone, intent, covers, targets, construct, location, audit results, and execution evidence are all retrievable via the query surface (vtest test show / list / query, 別紙A §12.2; 要件定義 §7).' 04b: 'SRC-to-Test reverse lookup is provided from scan results as derived data — fully rebuildable by vtest scan and never persisted as a second canon (基本仕様 §2.3, §3.3, §5.3; NFR-003/NFR-004).'

findings.reason: Two independent propositions: hash-input completeness (subject binds all logical fields, location, ExecutionDescriptor, construct — 基本仕様 §6.1, 詳細設計 §1.3) and hash computation ownership (core computes from hash-uncomputed DTOs; adapter must not self-finalize content_hash — 詳細設計 §1.3, 別紙C §18.3.1). An adapter could compute the hash itself over the complete subject: (1) violated, (2) holds.
findings.suggestion: 05a: 'The Test subject hash binds the full Test subject — adapter ID, Test ID, all logical fields (targets as declared TargetRef spellings, not resolved canonical Locators), Source Location, ExecutionDescriptor, and normalized construct bytes — so any change to covers, targets, intent, or execution coordinates necessarily changes the hash (基本仕様 §6.1; 詳細設計 §1.3).' 05b: 'Core computes the Test subject hash from the adapter's hash-uncomputed discovery DTO; an adapter must not self-finalize TestEntity.content_hash or SourceTarget.content_hash (詳細設計 §1.3; 別紙C §18.3.1).'

findings.reason: Single invariant (target identity fixes one-way to the canonical Locator, 詳細設計 §6.1.1) stated with its two facets: dual-addressing convergence to one target/hash and canonical-Locator-only persistence in Evidence/audits. Storing declared spellings would itself split identities, so the clauses are not independently falsifiable. Verbatim grounding in 詳細設計 §6.1 and 別紙C §18.3.1.

Same single-invariant structure as VO-06: the declared target set maps bijectively to distinct canonical targets — no reduction to a representative (要件定義 §8, 別紙A §14.3) and no canonical-level duplicates, with 詳細設計 §6.1.1 stating the uniqueness rule as the reason for E-SCAN-005. E-SCAN-005 is normative contract (詳細設計 §5.4, 別紙C §18.3.1), so G does not apply.

Single required/optional partition of the metadata contract with its complementary edge cases: intent mandatory (基本仕様 §6.2, E-SCAN-007 in 詳細設計 §5.4, MISSING derivation in 別紙C §18.3.1) while input/expect optional (要件定義 §9: 具体的入力値を必須としない). Operationally decidable and falsifiable in both directions.

Two independent propositions: registration granularity (one Test Entity per table-driven construct, per-case IDs not required — 要件定義 §10) and hash canonicalization order of cases (declaration-order encoding — 詳細設計 §1.3). A system could allow single-entity registration while sorting cases in the hash input, violating only the second.
findings.suggestion: 09a: 'A table-driven construct may register as exactly one Test Entity; decomposing internal cases into per-case Test IDs is not required (要件定義 §10; 基本仕様 §6.2 cases; 詳細設計 §4.2 repeatable case lines).' 09b: 'cases are order-significant in the Test subject hash: they are encoded in declaration order, so reordering cases changes the hash — unlike covers/targets/related, which are encoded in ascending normalized order (詳細設計 §1.3).'

findings.reason: Three independently falsifiable propositions over disjoint record classes are joined: (1) entity-store granularity (1 record = 1 file, no central ledger) can hold while Relations are mutated in place; (2) fact-record append-only creation can hold while SPEC/REQ/VO live in one aggregated file; (3) Relation immutability adds the delete-old+add-new change representation beyond (2). SPEC-BASIC §5.2 states these as separate bullets, not one invariant with edge cases.
findings.suggestion: Split into: (a) 'The canonical store has no central ledger: each SPEC/REQ/VO entity is exactly one file named by its ID, so parallel changes to different entities touch disjoint files.' (b) 'Relation/approval/audit/evidence records are created only as new ULID-named files and no operation edits an existing record file; a Relation change is expressed as deletion of the old record plus addition of a new record (Relations are immutable).'

findings.reason: Single trigger (Test ID collision in the cross-adapter merged discovery set) with its mandated consequences (E-SCAN-002, test_traceability=MISMATCH, no silent pick) — one invariant, not compound. Grounded verbatim in SPEC-BASIC §3.2/§7.1, 詳細設計 §5.4, 別紙C §18.3.1/§18.3.9. Absorbed REQ-ADAPTER-BOUNDARY#7 (inventory unpersisted) matches the cross-adapter-merge uniqueness check of 別紙C §18.3.9 — same truth condition.

Repository-wide SRC ID uniqueness with fail-closed collision handling (E-SCAN-011, no target selected, no candidate persisted to audit subjects/Evidence/target_execution) is one invariant plus its violation semantics, grounded verbatim in 詳細設計 §6.1/§5.4, SPEC-BASIC §3.2, 要件定義 §8, 別紙C §18.3.1. Absorbed REQ-TEST-REGISTRY#6 (inventory unpersisted) plausibly maps to 要件定義 §8's uniqueness/no-ambiguous-acceptance sentence — identical truth condition; no evidence of a different one.

One quantified invariant (every dangling canonical reference is flagged as an error driving non-PASS) with the reference kinds as its enumerated domain (E-SCAN-003/008/009/012), plus the covers-specific fail-closed complement (MISMATCH, entity retained per 詳細設計 §5.4 and 別紙C §18.3.1) — the allowed 'invariant + complementary edge cases' shape, not compound.

Two independent propositions: doctor's detection coverage (詳細設計 §16.2) versus hash-binding lapse semantics (approvals→draft, audits/evidence→STALE), which hold during any scan/verify even if doctor is never run. The lapse conjuncts are already owned by VO-APPROVE-02 (approval lapses to draft by derivation), VO-SEMAUDIT-04 (audit auto-STALE on subject change), and VO-EXEC-04 (evidence validity never PASS on breach), so splitting them out here would create duplicates.
findings.suggestion: Revise to the doctor-detection proposition only: 'vtest doctor detects post-merge logical inconsistencies that syntactic version-control merge accepts: duplicate Test IDs (E-SCAN-002), dangling references (E-SCAN-003/E-SCAN-009), and approved-VO content drift (reported via the approval's derived lapsed state).' Drop the hash-binding lapse conjuncts (owned by VO-APPROVE-02 / VO-SEMAUDIT-04 / VO-EXEC-04).

findings.reason: Single invariant — derived data is a pure function of canon and persistent cache is non-authoritative — with its complementary facets (rebuilt in-memory each run; cache never a verification input; cache loss leaves canon and results unchanged). Grounded verbatim in SPEC-BASIC §5.3 and 詳細設計 §2.3 (which also normatively covers the MCP mtime-rescan reading of 'every run').

Literal wording 'never in external records' is not what the refs state and is contradicted by designed behavior: SPEC-BASIC §2.3 says Evidence DOES carry target references as runtime snapshot keys — the norm is 'never duplicated as canon', not 'never present'. And the trailing 'so sync loss cannot occur' is a non-falsifiable rationale rider (§6.3's 構造的に発生しない) with no operational criterion, not a verification proposition.
findings.suggestion: Revise to: 'Test→VO (covers) and Test→SRC (targets) relations have their canon solely in adapter-owned metadata declarations and are never duplicated into external records as canon; the graph and current target set are always rebuilt from those declarations, and Evidence target references (runtime snapshot keys) are never used to generate or repair relations.' Drop 'so sync loss cannot occur'.

findings.reason: One concurrency contract from 詳細設計 §16.1 stated with its facets: no inter-process arbitration/locking, judgment = pure read of canon at that instant (operational criterion: output depends only on canon content read), and next-run reflection of canon changes. Falsifiable via concurrent runs against fixed canon snapshots; grounded verbatim ('ファイルロックを必要としない', '調停は行わない').

Two independent propositions with different failure modes are joined: (a) active REQ must declare >=1 spec_refs (structural presence; enforced at 別紙A vtest req add/edit, judged schema-invalid -> spec_coverage MISMATCH per 詳細設計 §11.1) and (b) each spec_refs.spec resolves to an existing SPEC record and current source (referential integrity; E-SCAN-012, vo_decomposition MISSING per §11.1.1). A REQ can satisfy either while violating the other. Clause (b) is verbatim the first clause of VO-INTAKE-05: absorbing REQ-SPEC-INTAKE#6 here merged a claim with a different truth condition and created a cross-area duplicate.
findings.suggestion: Part 1 (keep in this area): 'An active REQ declares one or more spec_refs: vtest req add/edit rejects an active REQ without a --spec/--section pair, a stored active REQ lacking spec_refs is schema-invalid (spec_coverage MISMATCH, never PASS), and a withdrawn REQ retains its refs but is excluded from spec_coverage's current corresponding-REQ set (詳細設計 §3.2).' Part 2: do NOT mint a new VO — fold the resolution clause into existing VO-INTAKE-05 and move the REQ-SPEC-INTAKE#6 provenance there.

findings.reason: Single value-function invariant with complementary edge cases; grounded verbatim in REQDEF §3 (quote), SPEC-BASIC §7.4, 詳細設計 §11.1 spec_coverage rules, 別紙C §18.3.5.

Quote verified in REQDEF §6 where 両者 = Spec->REQ intake completeness vs REQ->VO decomposition; reinforced by SPEC-BASIC §7.4 '取り込み完全性をこの監査で代用しない'. Falsifiable: two audit kinds stored separately with no substitution path.

'A coverage submission' conflates two kinds whose required reason structures differ: vo-coverage requires spec basis (SPEC ID+節)・分解観点・対象外条件と根拠 (SPEC-BASIC §7.4 — the quote and the vo_coverage consequence are vo-coverage-only), while spec-coverage requires 取り込んだ要求事項・対応REQ・exclusion根拠 (SPEC-BASIC §7.4 first half; 別紙C §18.3.4). Different input domains and failure modes = independent obligations; the quoted 'COMPLETE相当でも' sentence does not normatively cover spec-coverage.
findings.suggestion: Part 1: 'A vo-coverage submission whose reasons lack the SPEC-BASIC §7.4 structure (spec basis as SPEC ID+section, decomposition viewpoints, exclusions with spec grounds) is rejected even with verdict COMPLETE; vo_coverage stays non-PASS.' Part 2: 'A spec-coverage submission is accepted only when its reasons include the adopted requirements, the corresponding REQs, and the excluded passages with grounds (別紙C §18.3.4); otherwise it is rejected and spec_coverage stays non-PASS.'

findings.reason: Uniquely pins what the coverage subject set IS (current SPEC source hash + the complete corresponding active-REQ set / VO subtree — SPEC-BASIC §7.4, 詳細設計 §8.5), so a correspondence-set membership change alone STALEs prior verdicts. This is vtest's own designed staleness behavior, not a dogfood evidence-admissibility rule (H does not apply); not redundant with VO-SEMAUDIT-04, which does not fix the coverage subject-set definition.

Exactly 詳細設計 §11.1's vo_coverage value function (COMPLETE audit + all §3.5-valid subtree approvals -> PASS; zero VOs -> MISSING) — one check item's evaluation function, complementary conditions, not compound. Absorbed claims share the merged clauses' truth conditions (REQDEF §23: 未確定のVOを検証済みとして扱わない, project-age independent; approval gating clause), and general §3.5 approval validity is separately covered by VO-APPROVE-02/03, so no de-merge needed.

Joins two independent propositions: (a) deterministic materialization of the child-VO set per dimensions+coverage_policy (別紙C §18.3.1 'full-product VOは宣言partitionの直積を決定論的に実体化する'; 詳細設計 §3.3.1 rules) and (b) the responsibility split — deterministic checks judge only leaf-VO coverage while combination-space sufficiency belongs to the vo-coverage semantic audit (§3.3.1, the quoted sentence). Failure modes are independent: nondeterministic/incorrect expansion vs core syntactically judging sufficiency or checks looking past leaves.
findings.suggestion: Part 1: 'vtest vo expand materializes a child-VO set that is a deterministic function of dimensions and coverage_policy (independent-axes: one child per partition; full-product: one per cross-product element; explicit: only the listed combinations); repeated expansion of the same record yields the same set. Child IDs follow the documented default scheme (既定 — not an invariant).' Part 2: 'Deterministic checks (test_existence etc.) judge only materialized leaf-VO coverage; whether the combination space suffices for the Specification is judged solely by the vo-coverage semantic audit, never by a core syntactic judgment.'

findings.reason: The second clause 'its existence alone never counts as completed independent verification of each covered viewpoint' names no check item or system state — 'completed independent verification' is not a value anywhere in the design, so the clause is undecidable as worded — and it is the REQDEF §5.3 requirement sentence verbatim (restated without design-level operationalization). The design's operational form is 詳細設計 §11.3 + §3.3.1.
findings.suggestion: Revise to: 'A Test covering multiple VOs participates independently in each covered VO's fail-closed composition, and per-viewpoint satisfaction (test_existence, combination coverage) is judged per materialized leaf VO (§3.3.1/§11.3): a multi-VO Test never satisfies a leaf VO it does not cover.' Leave combination-space sufficiency to the VO-PLAN-07 split to avoid minting a new duplicate.

findings.reason: Matches 詳細設計 §11.1.1 verbatim (structural inputs only; only E-SCAN-008/012 and subtree-scoped E-SCAN-009/010 affect it; Test ID / metadata / target-resolution / adapter-parse / Evidence errors map to other dimensions). Directly falsifiable by injecting each error class and observing vo_decomposition.

Dedup criterion in reverse: identical truth condition to VO-INTAKE-05's opacity clause ('section is a non-empty opaque citation core never parses; no syntactic in-body check can yield PASS') — both derive from the same sentences of 詳細設計 §3.2 — yet the two were never merged, leaving a same-obligation duplicate across areas. Its only additional content is the single movable sentence 'citationの意味的妥当性は§8の監査理由で検証する'.
findings.suggestion: DROP this VO; fold 'semantic validity of the citation is confirmed only through §8 audit reasons' into VO-INTAKE-05 (owned by the intake area) and record REQ-VERIFICATION-PLANNING provenance there.

findings.reason: The claim drops the second sentence of its own quote (BASIC §4.2: 項目の部分集合を指定した実行は限定scopeであり、完全検証として表示または集約しない) — the prohibition on labeling/aggregating a limited-scope run as full verification, also normative in ACCEPT §18.3.5 (「完全検証」と表示しない) and IFACE §12.2. Cross-checking all 118 claims, no other VO owns this label prohibition: AGG-04's scope banner is a different truth condition (a report could state the requested scope AND still wrongly print 完全検証OK). Since the absorbed REQ-REPORTING#1 is a reporting-angle claim on this exact quote, it is the most plausible lost provenance — an obligation with a different truth condition (display labeling vs evaluation-set identity) was merged and its content dropped.
findings.suggestion: Revise to restore the missing facet as part of the single 'identity of full verification' invariant: "Full verification evaluates exactly the fixed 12 check items; omitting item scope selects all 12; no config value (including compat fields) can shrink or redefine the set; and a run with an explicit item subset is treated as limited scope, never displayed or aggregated as full verification."

findings.reason: Compound: clause 1 (per-level parent-child fail-closed composition) and clause 2 (any single non-PASS item in scope forces overall NG) are independent propositions with disjoint failure modes — tree roll-up can be correct while the overall verdict is computed wrongly (e.g. via repository-level items outside the Test→VO→REQ→SPEC chain), and vice versa. The ontology itself already treats clause 2 as a separate obligation: it is VO-REPORT-01's claim verbatim ('a single non-PASS value on any item or entity forces the overall result to NG'). Dropping it loses no coverage (full-run overall NG = REPORT-01; non-promotion = REPORT-02; repository-level witness = AGG-05).
findings.suggestion: Revise to the hierarchical composition only, carrying the design-level sharpening over REQDEF §19's '基本とする' baseline (BASIC §4.3 makes it unconditional, drops the Feature level, and fixes the non-PASS set): "Hierarchical aggregation Test→VO→REQ→SPEC is unconditionally fail-closed at every level: a parent is PASS only when all its children are PASS; any of the seven non-PASS values (FAIL/MISMATCH/MISSING/STALE/NOT_EXECUTED/NOT_CHECKED/UNKNOWN) in even one child makes the parent non-PASS."

findings.reason: Two independently primitive obligations joined by ';': (1) representative-value selection at the parent by the fixed priority order, and (2) lossless retention of every child value and every coexisting ground in detail output (DETAIL §11.1: すべてを根拠として保持). Disjoint failure modes and different verification procedures — the selector can pick the wrong representative while detail is complete, or the representative can be right while detail drops a child value/ground. Not a case-split of one rule over a partitioned input domain. Additionally VO-REPORT-03 states the identical compound for REQ-REPORTING, violating the ontology's own dedup convention (one VO per obligation, referencing every stating requirement).
findings.suggestion: Split into: (a) "When multiple non-PASS child values coexist, the representative value displayed at the parent is exactly the highest-priority value per the fixed order FAIL>MISMATCH>MISSING>STALE>NOT_EXECUTED>NOT_CHECKED>UNKNOWN." (b) "Detail output retains every child's individual value and all coexisting non-PASS grounds; representative selection loses no information at detail level." Coordination: absorb VO-REPORT-03 into the split parts (add REQ-REPORTING to requirements, record absorbed provenance) — REPORT-03 is outside this area, flagged for the orchestrator.

findings.reason: Compound: BASIC §4.4 sentence 2 (out-of-scope items retain NOT_CHECKED and are never converted to PASS — an aggregation/state invariant) and sentence 3 (output must state the requested scope and that out-of-scope items are unverified — a disclosure obligation, also IFACE §12.2 '出力冒頭に…必ず表示する') are independently falsifiable in different components: an implementation can keep NOT_CHECKED but omit the scope banner, or print the banner while promoting NOT_CHECKED to PASS. Disjoint failure modes, different verification procedures (derived values vs output text). The 'scoped OK means only scope OK' semantics is the shared rationale, not a third proposition.
findings.suggestion: Split into: (a) "Out-of-scope check items retain NOT_CHECKED in the derived results and are never converted to PASS; a scoped run's OK asserts only the requested scope." (b) "Scoped-run output (text and JSON) must state the requested scope and that out-of-scope items are unverified." Absorbed REQ-REPORTING#3 / REQ-INTEGRATION#5 (reporting/CI-angle statements of the disclosure) belong to part (b).

findings.reason: Single invariant (entity scope never narrows the repository-level Discovered Test set — DETAIL §11.1, IFACE §12.2) stated with its derived witness ('so': one unmanaged test forces overall NG even with all 11 graph items PASS — the ACCEPT §18.3.5 quote itself, following from the invariant plus AGG-02/REPORT-01 fail-closed). Splitting would manufacture a duplicate corollary. Absorbed REQ-EXISTING-PROJECT#2/#6 slices over other value domains (missing canon, unconfirmed VO, unexecuted audits) are independently owned by EXIST-02/03, PLAN-06, SEMAUDIT-05, EXEC-05/07 — no evidence of lost truth conditions.

Adds design-level content over the REQDEF §19 quote: the per-finding completeness (entity + check item + value + ground references to audit record ID / Evidence ID) and both output formats are normative in BASIC §7.10; 'text and JSON' is one obligation quantified over formats, not a compound. Decidable by inspecting report output for each NG.

One never-PASS invariant (capability absence is never supplemented to PASS) case-split over a partitioned input domain (static/coverage→NOT_CHECKED, runner→NOT_EXECUTED, analysis limit→UNKNOWN) — not compound; verbatim normative in BASIC §7.10. Note for the orchestrator: this VO is the canonical owner of the capability-gap mapping; VO-REPORT-02, VO-ADAPTER-04, and VO-INTEG-06 (outside this area) carry duplicate secondary clauses that should be absorbed here per the dedup convention.

Compound: DETAIL §11.3 sentence 1 (internal-dependency evaluation never changes out-of-scope display values — a non-interference invariant on the aggregator) and sentence 2 (runtime-proofed static_audit cites Evidence ID and per-target target_execution result — a citation obligation on the report) are independent: values can stay untouched while the citation is missing, or the citation can be present while an out-of-scope target_execution display flips. One obligation forbids changing output, the other requires adding to it — disjoint failure modes, different verifiers. The claim also omits §11.3's third sentence (non-PASS internal-dependency state presented as ground in limited scope), which belongs with the citation half.
findings.suggestion: Split into: (a) "When the aggregator evaluates Evidence freshness and per-target target_execution as internal dependencies of static_audit (§7.3) outside the item scope, the report values of those out-of-scope items remain NOT_CHECKED; internal evaluation never changes any out-of-scope display value." (b) "A static_audit value derived via runtime proof cites in the report the Evidence ID and the per-target target_execution result used; when internal-dependency STALE/non-satisfaction causes static_audit non-PASS in limited scope, that internal-dependency state is presented as the ground." Both grounded in DETAIL §11.3 and ACCEPT §18.3.2; absorbed REQ-REPORTING#8 belongs to part (b).
